interactions.flavorLineOne:
"Ascendant Alloys, curious…" Master Rahool looks up from his research.

"These are rare materials that only manifest in specific areas of conflict. While Banshee and I can provide this material to Guardians, our supplies are quite limited. If you need larger quantities of these Alloys, you will need to seek out these conflict zones."

• Ascendant Alloys can be purchased in limited quantities from Banshee-44 and Master Rahool in the Tower.

• These Alloys also can be acquired from weekly campaign missions in the Throne World, and from the Wellspring activity in the Throne World.
Rahool's mouth tightens at your approach, but he is polite enough as he accepts the gift.

headerDisplayProperties.description: We watch. We learn. We improve.

headerDisplayProperties.description: When we witness greatness, we spread the word so that others can marvel in it with us.
headerDisplayProperties.name: Twitch Bounty Reward: Gifting Subs

interactions.flavorLineOne:
As you stroll through the Tower, Rahool waves you over.
 
"Guardian," he calls, "I have been meaning to thank you. The data we have been able to recover over the years has been invaluable to rebuilding the archives. I know you have a lot of options for cryptarchs here in the Tower, and I hope you know that your loyalty has not gone unnoticed."
 
You've never seen another cryptarch here, but before you can ask about them, he barrels onward.
 
"I know, I know. Words without action are only so much bluster. But I have something special for you," he says, reaching into his pocket, "I've been working on a new technique for focusing the results of exotic engrams. Now, I wouldn't do this for just anyone who asked. But for a loyal client like yourself…"
 
Rahool produces a small and battered card, handing it over to you with a flourish.

Rahool beams as he adds the final stamp to your card.

"You've done me a great service, Guardian. I've collected enough data now that I can decipher brand new patterns for you. Take a look, see if there's anything you'd like to try."

He opens his focusing catalog, sliding it towards you.

Master Rahool greets you warmly. You dig through your pockets for your stamp card but can't find it.

Luckily, he doesn't seem to mind. "Don't worry, Guardian. I'll get you another card." He holds one out for you. It's new, but somehow already wrinkled.

"As usual, keep decrypting to earn stamps. Once you have enough stamps, I'll have enough data to grant you access to more advanced decryption techniques."

headerDisplayProperties.description: By supporting our fellow Guardians, we support humanity's survival.

displayProperties.subtitle: Your Light in Dark Times
displayProperties.description: Your Ghost has been by your side all along. No matter what.
displayProperties.name: Ghost

interactions.flavorLineOne:
The Witness's presence inside the Traveler has manifested as psychic wounds, spreading physical corruption through its Pale Heart. 

These concentrations of Darkness are dangerous. Ghost claims that the damage he took while fighting the Witness's possession is superficial, but you recognize when he's lying. 

Both he and the Traveler are very hurt—and things are only going to get worse if you don't find a way to stop the Witness. 

The Vanguard Warlock, Ikora, will know what to do. You must find her.

Ghost believes that Cayde-6's body is a construct of Light. His mysterious revival inside the Traveler's Pale Heart has changed him in ways that cannot yet be understood. 

You've changed, too. 

Unlocked by the vision you received from the Traveler upon your arrival, new powers flow through you. As momentous a discovery as this is, Ghost is insistent that you partner with Cayde to track down the other Vanguard operatives who have found their way here. 

Partner with Cayde to locate the Crow and his Ghost, Glint.

Believing there to be no other options in the fight against the Witness, Commander Zavala has left camp on a mission to give himself to Darkness. 

What's worse is that he might not be wrong. If the Traveler can't provide you with answers about what to do next, then maybe the entity that reached out to Zavala can. 

Whatever happens, he shouldn't have to face it without his Ghost. Partner with Targe to prevent Zavala from losing himself to Darkness.

Although the Vanguard has been reunited at last, their mood is not as celebratory as Ghost hoped. 

Ikora believes that Zavala's encounter with the Witness has left him emotionally compromised and requires some time alone with him to assess the situation. She and the Commander will meet your fireteam up ahead. 

For now, a mountain erected from the memory of Old Russia stands between you and the Witness's monolith. Ascend.

Ghost is shaken by the Traveler's message: "Devotion, Bravery, Sacrifice, Death." 

He doesn't know what reason the Traveler has for reiterating the old creeds, but it's made him reassess what's important to him—and what's most important to Ghost is his Guardian. You. 

You're in this together, until the end.   

When you're ready, it's time to press on. The Witness's monolith looms large on the horizon…

Evidence points to the Witness weaponizing the Traveler's Light to reshape reality, just as the Traveler once terraformed planets and created Ghosts to raise Guardians. What you've seen inside the Pale Heart is only the beginning. 

It believes itself to be a god of both Light and Darkness. And what are you, if not a god-killer? 

The only members of your fireteam unaccounted for are Commander Zavala and his Ghost, Targe. Locate them before the Witness does.

Ghost is confident that all signs point to the Traveler playing an active role in your fight against the Witness and its forces. Unlike Zavala, his faith seems unshakable. 

For the first time in his life as a Guardian, Zavala wishes to look to the Darkness for answers, but both Cayde and Ikora believe that it's worth trying to commune with the Traveler again instead. 

Regardless of who's right or who's wrong, you must at least try. Find a reliable way to connect with the Traveler.

At the cost of his Light and his Ghost, Zavala has made contact with dissenting voices within the Witness—and has discovered that they hold the key to defeating it. 

You won't allow Targe's sacrifice to amount to nothing. Neither will your Ghost, but the time for mourning will come later. 

Journey with the Vanguard to the memory of the place where the Witness was created and reconnect with the Dissenters.

interactions.flavorLineOne:
"Aghol. Totality Armorer. And you're the Lightbearer who's raised such a ruckus around the place."

The Armorer eyes you up and down. "Well, I don't mind a bit of a ruckus myself. There are plenty of abandoned drop pods scattered across Sol's old battlefields. Easy enough to recover and repurpose as artillery."

"Even Guardians know, nothing outside the pod survives contact with the pod." Aghol laughs loudly, and hands you a beacon.

Armorer Aghol clears his throat. "Got some more legalese for you, Lightbearer. You ready?"

"'The Totality Division is grateful for your continued support. The rewards promised you are being held in escrow by Spider. If you have any issues with the delivery, we request that you take it up with him. With regards from Enforcer Rao."

"Glad I don't have to write that stuff myself," Aghol says. "But we mean it."

Aghol scratches his chin. "Looking for a Syndicate to ally with? I won't say we couldn't use you, Guardian. And you couldn't do better than the Totality Division.

"One thing about the Division is, Rao doesn't brook any nonsense. We won't mess with your Glimmer. We share resources accordingly. What am I gonna do with a Praxic Blade, cut my hand off? Any mods come in, they're earmarked for you—if you earn 'em."

"I'll see you back here soon, yeah?"
Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Totality Division War Chest to earn Reputation with this Syndicate. Earn Renegade Abilities, Praxic Blade modifications, gear, and currency.
